delivery_kind for the linked PR(s): 'partial' ships a slice of the plan, 'complete' ships the whole thing (default: partial). A track closes only when EVERY linked PR is 'complete' (_delivery_hold in track_reconciler.py): one explicit 'partial' holds it, so when the last slice merges, re-link every PR of the track with --delivery complete. Fail-closed ONLY once migration 0032 (track_pr_delivery) is applied to this DB; if it is missing, pr_ref is still linked but the delivery marking is NOT recorded (a loud stderr error and --json 'error' field say so; apply 0032 and re-run to record it)
